figurative_meaning_en: In a derogatory sense, excessive cleverness or trickery
example_sentences_in_bangla: বেশি ওস্তাদি করিস না, একদিন ধরা পড়ে যাবি।
সে ওস্তাদি করে সবাইকে ঠকাতে চায়।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't show too much ostadi, you'll get caught one day.
He tries to trick everyone with his ostadi.
note: The idiom warns against overconfidence in cunning behavior, common in Bengali oral traditions.
